body:
- llama : do not map foreign ranges into a backend buffer

A buffer created from a host pointer pins everything that it wraps. When

several contexts share the same file (lazy tensors, MoE tensors kept on the

CPU with -cmoe), the single buffer that spans the first and the last tensor

of a context also wraps the ranges owned by the other contexts, pinning data

that the backend never reads.

For models with per-layer token embeddings this pins the whole lazy tensor

into the GPU buffer (27 GiB for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ4_NL), defeating the

point of reading it lazily.

Instead, compute the file ranges of each context and subtract the ranges

owned by the other contexts, then create one buffer per range. Weights that

are mapped in more than one context (e.g. token_embd.weight) keep being part

of the range of every context that uses them.

Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

- llama : enable prefetch on macOS

The prefetch hint of the tensors marked as prefetchable is a no-op on macOS,

so their pages are faulted in one by one while the graph runs. madvise

(MADV_WILLNEED) behaves as expected here, so add the platform to the guard.

With the lazy per-layer token embeddings of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ4_NL read

from a cold file cache, prompt processing goes from 356 / 375 / 475 t/s to

735 / 749 / 788 t/s for pp512 / pp2048 / pp4096.

- llama : use a plain buffer list per context
summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11599版本，重点重构了后端缓冲区映射机制。此前多Context共享文件时会导致外部范围被误锁至GPU显存（如懒加载逐层Embedding模型中锁定高达27 GiB冗余显存），新版通过精准计算各Context文件范围有效解决了显存浪费。此外，该版本为macOS引入了madvise预取支持，使得冷文件缓存下的Prompt处理速度由原来的300-400 t/s大幅跃升至700+ t/s。
